clips.title: The story
paras: In Stormwind's Trade District, Renato Gallina calls travelers toward his family's winery.

Renato Gallina calls to passers-by among the Trade District stalls, proclaiming his family's vintages the finest in Stormwind. The Gallina family runs a winery along the Canals, and Renato promotes it with pamphlets. Travelers can bring one to his sister Suzetta at the shop for a free bottle of wine.
